preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
For each test case, N must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: len(S) == 2 * N and all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The binary string S must have a length of 2*N and consist only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(valid_partition_exists(S) for _ in range(T)) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid partition exists for any test case, output -1.

postconditions.expression: any(len(A) == N and all(0 <= A[i] < 2 * N for i in range(N)) for A in valid_partitions)
postconditions.description: If a valid partition exists, output N distinct indices in increasing order.
